title: Summer Game Fest Unity Games Recap
summary: Discover the Made with Unity Games featured in Summer Game Fest 2026.
body_markdown:
**A Big Week for Game Announcements**


Day of the Devs wasn't the only place to find exciting Unity game news at Summer Game Fest 2026. Throughout the week, studios shared announcements and updates across a range of showcases. Here's a roundup of more Unity games we're looking forward to:


*[Bad Magpie](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4278970/Bad_Magpie/)* (Milktooth Games) was announced at the Xbox Games Showcase and is coming in 2027.


[lily's world XD](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195580/lilys_world_XD/) (SonderingEmily) announced that a playable demo is available now, featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase.


[Am I Nima](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224600/Am_I_Nima/) (HO! Games) was featured in the Story-Rich Showcase and announced a release date of October 8, 2026.


[Shroom and Gloom](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271280/Shroom_and_Gloom/) (Team Lazerbeam) was featured at the PC Gaming Show, where a new demo was announced alongside confirmation that the game is coming to Early Access in 2026.


[Big Walk](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478500/Big_Walk/) (House House) was featured in the June 2026 Nintendo Direct and announced a release date of August 4, 2026.
